toolsPreview.name: get_market_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Get metadata for active Elon tweet markets. No authentication required. Returns market IDs, questions, and basic info.

toolsPreview.name: get_trading_signals
toolsPreview.description: Get EV-based trading signals for Elon tweet markets with Kelly criterion sizing. Requires PRO tier API key. Use when you need actionable trading recommendations.

toolsPreview.name: get_crypto_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Get metadata for crypto markets. No authentication required. Returns market IDs and basic crypto market info.

toolsPreview.name: get_recent_tweets
toolsPreview.description: Get recent Elon tweets with metadata. FREE tier limited to 15 tweets, PRO tier gets up to 100. Use for understanding recent tweet context.

toolsPreview.name: get_predictions
toolsPreview.description: Get predictions for active Elon tweet markets with forecast percentiles. FREE tier gets limited data, PRO tier gets full predictions. Use for market analysis.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_portfolio
toolsPreview.description: Analyze a wallet's positions with EV-based recommendations. Requires PRO tier API key. Use for portfolio optimization and position analysis.

toolsPreview.name: get_rebalancing_recommendations
toolsPreview.description: Get rebalancing recommendations for a wallet's positions. Requires PRO tier API key. Use when you need to adjust existing positions based on new signals.

toolsPreview.name: check_health
toolsPreview.description: Check Polystrike API health status. No authentication required. Use for debugging or verifying API availability.
